title: 第11章 两大神兽第12章 拿捏
slug: 绑定生子系统后我御兽封神
content_zh:
黎漠看着这熟悉的令牌，眉头微微皱了起来。
他神情严肃：“宋师妹，你接了照顾神兽的任务？你可知道，这个任务，没有你想的那么简单？”
宋荞点了点头：“我知道啊。但我觉得，我挺招神兽喜欢的。神兽一看见我，指定就会留下我。”
她自信地理所当然。
黎漠沉静的脸上，都不由出现了一丝裂缝。
他的嘴唇不由抽搐了一下。
这位宋师妹，怕是受到的打击太大了，导致精神都有些失常了。
但是。
他身为宗门大师兄，有义务保护好宗门的师弟师妹们。
黎漠缓声说道：“神兽这几年的脾气越来越糟糕。到时候，我说什么，你做什么，千万不要做多余的事情。万一神兽发怒，我也能替你抵挡一些。”
黎漠神情严肃，说起来来，更是一板一眼的，活脱脱一个小老头。
宋荞歪头看着他。
之前，楚风眠没少跟她说黎漠的坏话，他说这个大师兄只会装，说他看起来一本正经，私底下不知道藏着什么坏水。
事实证明。
黎漠是真正的端方君子，他平日里一直护着宗门的师弟师妹，到生死之际，也依旧是这么做的。
宋荞看着他一直古井无波的面容，突然有些好奇。
这位大师兄……真的就不会露出其他表情的吗？
宋荞看了一眼系统面板。
面板上，和大师兄深情相拥的任务还显示在那里。
有什么办法，能和这种禁欲系小老头深情相拥？

“走吧。记住我说的话，千万不要行差踏错。”黎漠嘱托了一句，然后向前走去。
宋荞老实跟上，顺手解除了系统的静音设置。
解除后，系统还是没有发出任何声音。
宋荞不由惊奇了：“系统，你哑巴了？怎么不说话了？”
系统忍了又忍，没忍住：“我以为你喜欢哑巴系统呢。”
宋荞挑了挑眉：“你这么说的话，哑巴系统好像也挺好的。”
她又打算去点静音键。
系统顿时急了：“等等，你等等！我这次，也没说什么你不爱听的话啊？”
宋荞笑了：“原来，你知道你之前说话不中听。”
系统委屈了：“但我也是为了你好！宿主，你不抓紧做攻略任务，要到猴年马月，才能强大起来。”
“谁说我不做了？”宋荞目光闪动。
系统顿时来了精神：“对吧对吧，任务还是要做的。黎漠就在眼前，宿主快去跟他拉近关系。对付这种冰块，就要用水磨工夫，用你日积月累的温柔感化他，总有一天，他会主动拥抱你。”
“那才是要等到猴年马月。”宋荞不由嘟囔了一句。
她的目光闪动着。
黎漠是宗门大师兄，一身修为，已经是金丹巅峰，距离元婴，也只有一步之遥。
直接强上，那肯定是不行的。她打不过。
让爷爷把他绑起来，自己强行抱一个？这倒是可以。就怕爷爷脑补过多，非得让自己负责。
偏偏她没打算负责的。
再忍忍！
今天，她一定能够找到机会，完成这个任务。
content_en:
Li Mo looked at the familiar token and frowned slightly.
He looked serious: "Junior sister Song, you took over the task of taking care of the divine beast? Do you know that this task is not as simple as you thought?"
Song Qiao nodded: "I know. But I think I am quite popular with the mythical beast. As soon as the mythical beast sees me, it will definitely keep me."
She takes it for granted.
A crack appeared on Li Mo's calm face.
His lips twitched involuntarily.
This junior sister Song may have been hit too hard, causing her to become mentally disturbed.
but.
As the eldest brother of the sect, he has the obligation to protect the junior brothers and sisters of the sect.
Li Mo said slowly: "The temper of the mythical beast has become worse and worse in the past few years. When the time comes, do what I say and do what you do, and don't do anything unnecessary. If the mythical beast gets angry, I can also resist it for you."
Li Mo looked serious, and when he spoke, he was even more serious, just like a little old man.
Song Qiao tilted her head and looked at him.
Before, Chu Fengmian often spoke ill of Li Mo to her. He said that this senior brother could only pretend, saying that he looked serious and had no idea what bad things he was hiding in private.
It turns out.
Li Mo is a true gentleman. He always protects his sect's junior brothers and sisters, and he still does so even in life and death.
Song Qiao looked at his calm face and suddenly became curious.
This senior brother... really won't show other expressions?
Song Qiao glanced at the system panel.
On the panel, the task of embracing the senior brother affectionately is still displayed there.
Is there any way to embrace this ascetic little old man affectionately?
"Let's go. Remember what I said, don't make any mistakes." Li Mo warned, and then walked forward.
Song Qiao followed up and unmuted the system.
After being released, the system still did not make any sound.
Song Qiao couldn't help but be surprised: "System, are you mute? Why don't you speak?"
The system endured it again and again, but couldn't hold it back: "I thought you liked the dumb system."
Song Qiao raised his eyebrows: "If you put it that way, the mute system seems to be pretty good."
She planned to click the mute button again.
The system suddenly became anxious: "Wait, wait! I didn't say anything you didn't want to hear this time, right?"
Song Qiao smiled: "So, you know what you said before was not pleasant to listen to."
The system felt aggrieved: "But I am doing it for your own good! Host, if you don't hurry up and complete the strategy mission, you will have to wait until the Year of the Monkey to become stronger."
"Who said I won't do it?" Song Qiao's eyes flashed.
The system suddenly became energetic: "Right, right? The task still needs to be done. Li Mo is right in front of you. Host, go and get closer to him. To deal with this kind of ice cube, you have to work hard with water and use your accumulated tenderness to influence him. One day, he will take the initiative to hug you."
"Then we have to wait until the year of the monkey and the month of the horse." Song Qiao couldn't help but muttered.
Her eyes flashed.
Li Mo is the eldest brother of the sect. His cultivation is already at the peak of the Golden Core, and he is only one step away from the Nascent Soul.
It will definitely not work if you force him directly. She can't beat it.
Let grandpa tie him up and forcefully hold him? That's fine. I'm afraid that grandpa has too much imagination and has to make himself responsible.
But she had no intention of taking responsibility.
Bear with me any longer!
Today, she will definitely find an opportunity to complete this task.
